purpose: One reusable distribution per match should feed prediction, score matrix, scenario families and tournament simulation.

inputs.missingness_contract: Every optional family carries availability counts, null indicators and source-date bounds.

score_matrix.tail_policy: explicit high-score/tail mass in future contract

outputs.score_repere: Exact modal score without first-level percentage emphasis.
outputs.representative_scores: Scores selected to represent important scenario families.
outputs.odds_value: Consumes the same market probabilities when bookmaker data is available.

consumers.match_card: Use score repere plus scenario families.
consumers.score_matrix_ui: Show scenario probabilities before exact-score percentages.
consumers.road_to_the_trophy: May consume only after arbitrary future matchup inference and tournament replay validation.
consumers.group_simulation: Sample from the same distribution once promoted.
consumers.knockout_simulation: Use the same 90-minute distribution plus explicit extra-time/penalty contract.

promotion_gates: Beat quant_hybrid_v2.2 on chronological validation and test log loss/Brier.
Improve or preserve draw, favorite, upset and large-score calibration.
Pass leakage audit for lagged statistics.
Validate arbitrary future matchups and Road to the Trophy replay before tournament integration.
